name: Company hero over full-viewport background video
purpose: Open the company page with a full-screen brand moment: the mission H1, a one-line lead and demo / ask-AI CTAs.
description: Full-viewport header (/company; min-h 100svh, max 60rem) with a background-video slot under a 50% black wash and a bottom-up #00030a gradient; white centred content sits at the bottom: serif 4rem/1.1 H1 (2.5rem <=767), 20px lead, primary button and a dark 'ask AI' button with an icon track. Buttons wrap and stretch <=479.
